rows: The **post-Bhopal umbrella** under Art 253 (Stockholm implementation): sweeping central powers — standards for emissions-effluents-hazardous substances, area restrictions (**eco-sensitive zones**, CRZ flow from it), entry-inspection, closure-directions (**Sec 5**), citizen suits (Sec 19); rules ecosystem — EIA-2006, CRZ, waste-rules families, noise rules all hang from it

The enabling giant: flexible, delegated, judicially super-charged (Art 21 + PIL made it constitutional ecology); critiques — executive-heavy rule-making, penalties long trivial (**2023 Jan Vishwas amendments decriminalised minor violations into monetary penalties + adjudication officers** — deterrence-vs-ease debate), implementation via understaffed boards

**Sec 2**: no de-reservation/diversion of forest land for non-forest use without CENTRAL approval; compensatory afforestation + NPV payments; **Godavarman (1996-)** expanded 'forest' to dictionary meaning + the continuing mandamus that governs Indian forests

Slowed diversion from ~1.5 lakh ha/yr (pre-1980) to ~1.5-2 thousand-ha-scale annual grants — the great brake; critiques — CAMPA plantation quality, and the **2023 amendment's** exemptions (border-security linear projects, zoos-safaris, plantations on private land defined out) contested in the SC (status-quo-ish interim orders on 'forest' meaning)

**Schedules** (2022 amendment rationalised to **4** from 6: I-II protection tiers, III vermin-adjacent handling, IV CITES-implementation schedule), **protected-area ladder — National Parks, Sanctuaries, Conservation & Community Reserves**; authorities — NBWL, **NTCA (statutory 2006; tiger reserves ~55+)**, WCCB; hunting-trade prohibitions

The species-and-spaces law: tiger recovery (~3,680, 2022 census — 75% of the world's), PA network ~5.3% of area; critiques — inviolate-space vs FRA rights tension, vermin-declaration politics, chronic vacancy-funding gaps

sections.heading: Reading the trio — and the AP register

items: **Division of labour**: EPA regulates the **brown** (pollution-hazard) file, FCA the **land-use gate**, WPA the **green (species-spaces)** file — with the courts as the fourth statute (Godavarman's forest definition; tiger-corridor jurisprudence; NGT's EPA enforcement).

**The rights counter-weight**: FRA 2006 + PESA cut across all three — conservation's legitimacy now runs through community consent (the inviolate-vs-inhabited debate; critical wildlife habitat's unused rigour).

**AP register**: EPA in action — Vizag ESZs, LG Polymers' NGT case; FCA — Polavaram's forest diversion (among India's largest single grants) + compensatory afforestation's audit; WPA — **Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve (India's largest)**, **Papikonda NP**, Coringa & Kolleru sanctuaries, red-sanders anti-smuggling task force (WPA-CITES mesh) — one AP case per act completes any answer.

**Recent shift:** the **Jan Vishwas Act (2023)** decriminalised many minor environmental offences (penalties over prosecution) — debated as ease-of-compliance vs dilution.

sections.heading: Biodiversity law, Paris, SDGs, disaster plan — the four-in-one

rows: CBD's domestic child: **three-tier machinery — NBA (national), State Biodiversity Boards, ~2.7 lakh Biodiversity Management Committees** with **People's Biodiversity Registers**; **access & benefit-sharing (ABS)** for bio-resources (Nagoya-aligned); **Biodiversity Heritage Sites**; 2023 amendment — decriminalisation, AYUSH-practitioner exemptions, faster approvals (bio-trade-vs-biopiracy debate)
Machinery built, benefit-sharing thin (₹-crore trickles vs use scale); PBRs patchy; the amendment eased business and worried conservationists — balance both

**Bottom-up NDCs** + 5-yearly **global stocktake (first: Dubai 2023 — 'transition away from fossil fuels')** + ratchet; goals — **well below 2°C, pursue 1.5°C**; finance-adaptation-loss&damage pillars; **Article 6** carbon markets operationalised (COP26-29)
Universality achieved where Kyoto leaked; the gap — NDCs sum to ~2.5-2.9°C: ambition-ratchet is the design bet; India's Panchamrit + LiFE the national face
**17 goals-169 targets, 2030 horizon**; integrated (indivisible) design; India's localisation — NITI index, state-district frames, budget-tagging pilots
Mid-point audit (2023 summit): most targets off-track globally (~12-15% on track); financing gap ~$4 tn; yet the framework's convening power endures — 'the world's shared syllabus'

India's **first national DM plan**, Sendai-aligned: responsibility matrices for **all phases across ministries**, the **five thematic areas** (understanding risk, IA coordination, DRR investment, capacity, climate-risk integration in 2019), no separate budget — 'mainstreaming' logic
Comprehensive on paper; the G-092 critique applies — funding bias to response, DDMA capacity, plan-to-drill distance; its Sendai-target mapping is the exam-quotable feature

items: **One genome of governance**: all four are **framework instruments** — machinery + targets + review cycles rather than command lists; their common weakness is the last mile (BMC registers, NDC ambition, SDG financing, DDMA drills) — one sentence that binds the note.

**The 2015 vintage**: Paris + SDGs + Sendai (with Addis Ababa finance) = the single greatest year of global goal-setting — frame them as one architecture ('the 2015 compact') and examiners see synthesis.

**AP register**: BMCs and PBRs across panchayats (medicinal-plant and fish-diversity registers), **ABS potential in red-sanders & medicinal flora**, SDG front-runner ranking, the state DM plan's cyclone playbook as NDMP's best field edition — plus **Kambalakonda-type urban biodiversity and the Godavari mangrove Biodiversity Heritage candidacies**.

sections.heading: Three revolutions — white, green(er), and green-pharmacy

rows: **Verghese Kurien/NDDB, Anand-Amul pattern**: village cooperative → district union → state federation; farmer-owned processing-marketing; EEC dairy-aid monetised into investment; **India → world's largest milk producer (~230+ MT, ~24% global)**

The institutional revolution: smallholder-women-centred (dairying's female workforce), price-spiral-free nutrition gains; critiques — regional skew (west-north strong), productivity per animal low, and the **AP note: strong buffalo economy (Chittoor-Godavari belts), cooperative revival attempts amid private-dairy dominance (Amul-AP entry MoUs, Sangam-Vijaya legacies)**
**HYV seeds (Borlaug wheat; IR rice) + irrigation + fertiliser + procurement-MSP**; **M.S. Swaminathan** the Indian architect; wheat-rice belts (Punjab-Haryana-west UP; the deltas for rice)

Food security won (ship-to-mouth → surplus exporter); costs — water mining, soil fatigue, pesticide load, regional-crop skew (the ED-018/IG-028 files); **Swaminathan's own 'Evergreen Revolution'** = productivity WITH ecology (the bridge to natural farming, millets, precision agri); **AP: delta rice bowl + the APCNF corrective born on the same soil**

The **medicinal-plants economy**: cultivation-conservation-processing of herbal pharmacopoeia — **National Medicinal Plants Board (2000)**, AYUSH mission's cultivation clusters, GAP/GACP standards, ABS under the BD Act; India's ~8,000-species ethnobotany, ~₹ multi-thousand-crore AYUSH-herbal industry (post-COVID surge)

Promise — farm diversification (high-value/acre), conservation-through-cultivation (relieving wild harvest ~90% of supply), export (with quality-standardisation the gate); risks — adulteration, unsustainable wild collection, biopiracy (the **neem-turmeric patent battles won by India** — cite them); **AP assets: Eastern-Ghats ethnobotany (Araku-Paderu belts), red-sanders adjacency, Tirupati's herbal-research institutions (SVIMS-adjacent ayurveda; TTD's herbal gardens)**

items: **Three engines**: Green = **technology push** (seeds-inputs-procurement); White = **institution push** (cooperatives owning the chain); Green-Pharmacy = **value-and-biodiversity push** (markets for conservation) — the engine-typology that organises any comparison.

**The equity contrast**: Green concentrated (irrigated belts, larger farmers initially); White dispersed (landless-and-smallholder friendly — a buffalo needs no acreage); Pharmacy potentially tribal-friendly (NTFP-ethnobotany zones) IF ABS and quality chains reach them — equity is design, not accident.

**The sequel agenda**: Evergreen (sustainability retrofit), **White 2.0** (productivity + methane management + A2-value plays), Pharmacy's standardisation (pharmacopoeial validation, cultivation-first supply) — each revolution now needs its correction, and AP hosts all three stories (delta rice + APCNF; buffalo belts + cooperative question; Ghats ethnobotany + ABS).

**Quote bank**: Kurien — 'India's dairy development is a story of institutions'; Swaminathan — 'if agriculture goes wrong, nothing else will have a chance to go right'; the neem-patent revocation (EPO 2000/2005) as biopiracy's defeat.

sections.heading: 🔬 Deep mastery — the 'revolutions', compared

rows: AP leads; PM Matsya Sampada Yojana
India as 'pharmacy of the world' — vaccines & generics

items: **What 'revolution' means:** a technology-plus-institutions leap (seeds+MSP; cooperatives+cold chain) that transforms output — not technology alone.
**The next revolution:** an **'Evergreen/Rainbow Revolution'** integrating productivity with sustainability, nutrition and climate resilience.

prelimsPointers: **White Revolution / Operation Flood** — Verghese Kurien; India is the world's largest milk producer.
**Blue Revolution** — fisheries; **Yellow Revolution** — oilseeds.

**Operation Flood (1970, NDDB — Verghese Kurien)**: Anand pattern three-tier cooperatives; India = **world's largest milk producer (~230+ MT, ~24% share)**; National Milk Day = Kurien's birthday (26 Nov).

**Green Revolution**: Borlaug's dwarf wheat + **M.S. Swaminathan** (Bharat Ratna 2024, posthumous); HYV-irrigation-fertiliser-MSP package; **'Evergreen Revolution'** is Swaminathan's sustainability sequel-concept.
**National Medicinal Plants Board (2000)** under AYUSH; ~**90% of herbal raw supply is wild-collected** — cultivation-first is the reform.
**Neem (EPO patent revoked) & turmeric (USPTO revoked)** — India's landmark anti-biopiracy victories (CSIR's TKDL the systemic answer).
**TKDL** — Traditional Knowledge Digital Library: prior-art database blocking wrongful patents.
AP dairy belts: **Chittoor & the Godavari districts (buffalo)**; cooperative-vs-private dairy is the state's live debate.
**Araku-Paderu (ASR district)** — Eastern-Ghats ethnobotanical zone; TTD (Tirupati) maintains herbal-garden and ayurvedic-research lineages.

Operation Flood built institutions before infrastructure — assess the Anand pattern and its AP unfinished chapter.
The Green Revolution fed India and billed its ecology — evaluate with Swaminathan's own Evergreen corrective.
Can markets conserve biodiversity? Examine the green-pharmacy proposition through NMPB, ABS and the biopiracy battles.
AP hosts all three arcs — delta rice to APCNF, buffalo belts, Ghats ethnobotany: write the state's triple narrative.
